answers.valueEn: Signs of a front accident on the right side; front right chassis is open and needs measurement; front right shock absorber mounted with non-matching bolts; alignment tool work (Zargina). Strong hit in the front right fender rail. Sound from the steering box. Transmission selector damage; car does not shift to Park and only starts on Neutral. Strong oil leaks from engine and gearbox below. Internal gearbox repair/overhaul. Engine overhaul with signs of disassembly on all engine parts; oil leak from valve cover. Welding in the left floor chassis with heavy putty. Broken front fiber core fixed with sheet metal and screws; broken front fog lights, grille, and fiber guides behind bumper. Strong hit in the cooling system which is held by one bolt. Cracks/welding in front headlight mounts. Cut in front left headlight wiring. Needs 4-way window switch. Front left window not working. Broken interior front left door trim. Peeling in internal dashboard and door chrome. Broken trunk fiber lining (right/left). Car pulls right due to chassis. Missing/broken rear wheel liners. Broken right fiber sill. Broken front bumper and grille. Two broken door mirrors and two broken sun visors. Cuts in 4 door seals. Missing rear right door handle. Sounds from door check straps. Broken rear bumper lights. Damaged rear wiper blades. Damaged interior door upholstery. Broken upper instrument cluster cover. Broken torpedo fiber and outer pillar fiber. Broken four AC vents. Peeling on outer door chrome. Fiber fender flares fixed with screws. Broken front wheel liners (left one custom-made and screwed). Severe corrosion on the roof and outer pillars near the windshield. Non-original Android screen.
